findings.claim: ADR-0004, 0005, 0006, 0012 and 0015 were not reviewed in r3.
findings.evidence: grep over REVIEW-r3.md, ISSUE-OUTCOMES-r3.md, BOTTLENECKS-r3.md: 0 mentions of 0004, 0005, 0006, 0012, 0015.
findings.fix: Run one r3 pass for each of these ADRs against the owner decisions.

findings.claim: The ADR deletes tier2-e2e-smoke.yml but does not name the E2E that replaces it. The owner wants E2E.
findings.evidence: 0015:50 'tier2-e2e-smoke.yml (it uses an API key)'. No link to the ADR-0012 keyless harness or the ADR-0003 golden E2E.
findings.fix: Map each deleted E2E workflow to the ADR-0003 or ADR-0012 test that replaces it.

findings.claim: The PR gates pass or fail on regex counts. This conflicts with 'no regex as decision' unless the ADR limits that rule to runtime code.
findings.evidence: 0005:18 'The regexes are in the script'; 0005:44-45 'caps regex = 0', 'doubt regex = 0'.
findings.fix: Say that the regex rule covers runtime code only, or make the lint report-only and leave the decision to review.

findings.claim: The alwaysLoad decision rests on one probe: one model (haiku-4-5) and one Claude Code version (2.1.283). Nobody re-checked it for Opus or Sonnet.
findings.fix: Add the probe to the ADR-0012 harness and run it on each Claude Code release.
